title: SY1 Factory 256
selection: Unique parameter sets whose sound agrees with the category their name gives in the Patch Manager (tools/factory_pick.mjs): near-even shares of 13 categories, Other kept small, round-robin across source banks, at most two of one name series (a category short of variety gives its places to the others), sounds new to the factory bank first. Every one renders audible, finite audio in the host test. This is not a claim of individual listening tests.
